positions.name: PallasineChecklistInstitutionalOrder
positions.frame: How is the Pallasine checklist established as the non-negotiable onboarding order?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the checklist's institutional authority from complementary directions: src-1 enacts it as a universal present-tense mandate ('every new hire completes'), while src-2 reports its supersession of the prior wiki page, placing it as the established order. The shared authority-ranking and conservation reads span both — one from prescription, one from institutional history — cohering under a single directional read of how the checklist is positioned as the settled onboarding regime.
